property_summary: When owner calls withdrawAll with recipient a non-payable account, reference version transfers exactly contract balance (1 ether), while buggy version tries to transfer balance+1 wei, causing revert due to insufficient balance.
When the owner (this test contract itself) calls withdrawAll with itself as recipient, the reference version succeeds and the modified version reverts because it requires msg.sender != owner.
The owner (address(this)) calls withdrawAll, but the modified contract requires msg.sender != owner, causing revert, while the reference allows it.
Deploy C, send 1 ether via fallback, call withdrawAll(address(this)): reference transfers 1 ether to caller (contract balance becomes 0), buggy transfers 0 ether (contract balance stays 1).

After sending 10 ether to the contract, the reference version sends the full 1 ether balance to a recipient on withdrawAll, while the buggy version sends 0 ether, leaving the full balance in the contract.
